title: Atmospheric Re-Entry
description: A simple mod that adds in atmospheric re-entry
body:
This is a surprisingly very simple mod, with one singular addition, if you fall from high enough, you will experience a phenomena known as atmospheric re-entry, pretty much, you light on fire and become a meteor, and when you hit the ground (unless you hit deep enough water) you make a massive explosion, killing you and surrounding mobs.

In other words, be careful with how high you go with elytra if you have this mod installed!
